Practice areas

Personal, property, business and dispute-resolution work.

The areas below reflect the firm's supplied client materials and Joyce Ndehi's publicly presented professional profile. Advice in any matter depends on its facts and documents.

Mediation & Alternative Dispute Resolution

Structured, confidential and impartial mediation support for family and succession disputes, land and property matters, employment and workplace disputes, commercial disagreements and other civil matters.

Succession, Probate & Estate Administration

Support with wills, grants of probate and letters of administration, distribution and administration of estates, family agreements and succession disputes.

Property & Conveyancing

Legal support around land and property transactions, documentation, due diligence, transfers and disputes affecting ownership or use.

Commercial, Corporate & Tax Advisory

Contracts, commercial legal questions, corporate matters and tax-related advisory support for individuals and businesses.

Data Protection & Intellectual Property

Advice on data-protection obligations, copyright and other intellectual-property matters relevant to organisations, professionals and creators.

Litigation & Legal Advisory

Legal strategy, drafting, negotiation and representation where a dispute or other matter requires formal legal action.
